title: LongRLVR: Long-Context Reinforcement Learning Requires Verifiable Context Rewards
authors_zh: Guanzheng Chen, Michael Qizhe Shieh, Lidong Bing
paper_type_zh: 长上下文强化学习与可验证奖励设计论文（ICLR 2026）
best_for_zh: 研究长上下文问答、RLVR、证据定位与训练奖励设计的读者。
one_line: LongRLVR trains long-context models with a verifiable reward for evidence selection as well as answer correctness.
LongRLVR 将证据块选择与最终答案同时纳入可验证奖励，使长上下文强化学习获得更稠密的定位反馈。
why: It makes the intermediate grounding record, rather than only the final answer, an explicit consumer of the RL objective.
inclusion_reason: It changes the RL training objective by making selected evidence chunks a supervised and reward-bearing part of each long-context record.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Outcome-only reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards gives credit only after a long-context model has both found all needed evidence and answered correctly. For multi-document questions, that joint event is rare early in training, so the learning signal for locating relevant passages can vanish even when the final-answer checker is reliable.

LongRLVR asks how to make contextual grounding an optimizable part of long-context RL rather than an unobserved internal step. It introduces a grounded QA training record and a reward that evaluates selected evidence chunks as well as the final answer, producing 46K synthetic records for this purpose.

只按最终结果给分的可验证强化学习，要求长上下文模型同时找齐所需证据并答对问题后才获得反馈。对于跨文档问题，这一联合事件在训练早期很少出现；即使答案检查器可靠，模型定位相关段落的学习信号也会消失。

LongRLVR 追问如何让上下文定位成为长上下文强化学习中可优化的部分，而不是不可观察的内部步骤。它提出带证据标注的问答训练记录，并让奖励同时评估所选证据块和最终答案，为此构造了 46K 条合成记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The training target is a grounded QA record: a long document split into chunks, a question, the identifiers of the useful chunks, and an answer. The policy must expose its evidence choice before answering, so that grounding becomes a visible training object rather than an inference hidden inside a final response.

LongRLVR combines an F-score-style reward over those identifiers with answer correctness. The first term supplies credit for partially correct evidence selection, while the second keeps the policy tied to answering the question; the contribution is therefore a changed reward interface for RL, not merely another long-context dataset.

训练目标是一条带定位信息的问答记录：由被切分为证据块的长文档、问题、有用证据块的标识符和答案组成。策略必须在作答前显式给出证据选择，因此定位不再隐藏在最终回复的推断过程里，而成为可见的训练对象。

LongRLVR 将这些标识符上的 F 分数式奖励与答案正确性结合。前一项会为部分正确的证据选择提供反馈，后一项则让策略仍以答对问题为目标；因此它的贡献是改变 RL 的奖励接口，而不只是再发布一个长上下文数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Source and segment documents: books, arXiv papers, and code documents between 8K and 64K tokens are split into 64 chunks and clustered with BGE-M3 embeddings. 2. Generate and filter QA: Qwen3-235B-A22B proposes a question, answer, and required chunks for each cluster, judges clarity, fidelity, and evidence necessity, and two-stage rejection sampling retains one high-scoring record per document.
  1. Make grounding explicit: a rollout emits selected chunk identifiers before its answer. 4. Score and optimize: the selected set receives a precision-recall F-score term, which is blended with answer reward and optimized with GRPO. The reported run trains for one epoch on 46K records, uses eight rollouts per prompt, and removes questions that the base model already answers easily; code, data, and checkpoints are released, but a full source-overlap audit is not reported.

1. 获取并切分文档：从书籍、arXiv 论文和代码文档中保留长度为 8K 到 64K 词元的内容，切成 64 个块后用 BGE-M3 向量聚类。2. 生成并筛选问答：Qwen3-235B-A22B 为每个簇提出问题、答案和所需证据块，再判断问题清晰度、答案忠实度和证据必要性；两阶段拒绝采样最终为每篇文档保留一条高分记录。
  1. 显式输出定位：一次 rollout 必须先输出所选证据块标识符，再给出答案。4. 打分并优化：所选集合获得基于精确率和召回率的 F 分数项，该项与答案奖励混合后由 GRPO 优化。报告中的训练在 46K 条记录上进行一轮，每个问题采样八次，并删去基模型已能轻易答对的问题；代码、数据和检查点已公开，但论文未报告完整的来源重叠审计。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main controlled comparison keeps the synthetic training data and base model fixed and changes SFT or answer-only GRPO into LongRLVR. For Qwen2.5-14B-1M, accuracy rises from 73.17 to 88.90 on RULER-QA and from 39.8 to 46.5 on LongBench v2; this supports the claim that the added grounding reward helps in the evaluated long-context settings, not that every retrieval task needs the same reward.

The paper also varies the curation choices while holding the Qwen2.5-7B-1M LongRLVR setup fixed. On LongBench v2, the best judge-rated QA records score 38.6, compared with 36.6 for median-rated and 34.8 for worst-rated records; this supports the importance of their synthetic-data filter, but the judge that supplies those quality scores is also the generator model.

主要的受控比较固定合成训练数据和基模型，只将 SFT 或仅按答案给分的 GRPO 替换为 LongRLVR。对 Qwen2.5-14B-1M，RULER-QA 的准确率从 73.17 提升到 88.90，LongBench v2 从 39.8 提升到 46.5；这支持新增的定位奖励能帮助所评测的长上下文设置，但不能说明每一种检索任务都需要同样的奖励。

论文还在固定 Qwen2.5-7B-1M LongRLVR 配置下改变数据构造选择。LongBench v2 上，评分最高的问答记录得到 38.6，中位评分记录为 36.6，最低评分记录为 34.8；这支持其合成数据过滤的重要性，但提供质量分数的判别器与生成器是同一个模型。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Standard RLVR treats evidence selection as latent behavior and rewards only the terminal answer. LongRLVR changes the record and objective so that chunk identifiers are emitted, compared against reference evidence, and rewarded before the final answer is evaluated.

The novelty is the verifiable intermediate grounding contract and its non-vanishing-gradient argument, rather than GRPO itself or the generic idea of generating synthetic QA. Its value depends on whether a task can supply sufficiently complete reference chunks; it is not a replacement for an external retrieval system or an audit of source-document provenance.

标准 RLVR 将证据选择视为隐含行为，只奖励终局答案。LongRLVR 改变了记录和目标：模型要输出证据块标识符，与参考证据比较并获得奖励，之后才评估最终答案。

它的新意是可验证的中间定位契约及其关于非消失梯度的论证，而不是 GRPO 本身，也不是泛泛的合成问答思路。其价值取决于任务能否提供足够完整的参考证据块；它不能替代外部检索系统，也不能替代对源文档来源的审计。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method assumes that a reference set of necessary chunks is available and that chunk-level F-score reflects useful grounding; incomplete references can punish valid alternative evidence or reward a superficially matching selection. Its 46K records are generated and quality-scored by Qwen3-235B-A22B, so reuse should separately audit generator/judge bias, document licenses, and overlap with evaluation corpora. The reported results cover controlled long-document QA, not an agent that retrieves from a changing external corpus.
该方法假设存在一组必要证据块的参考答案，并且块级 F 分数能反映有用的定位；不完整的参考集合可能惩罚同样有效的替代证据，或奖励表面匹配的选择。46K 条记录都由 Qwen3-235B-A22B 生成并评分，因此复用时应单独审计生成器与判别器偏差、文档许可证及其与评测语料的重叠。报告中的结果覆盖受控的长文档问答，而非从不断变化的外部语料检索的智能体。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when training a model must improve both evidence localization and final answering over a fixed long context. Starting from long documents, a generator, and a defensible evidence annotation scheme, reuse the record format and context-reward manager to create an RL dataset, then compare answer-only RLVR and the combined reward under the same base model and rollout budget. Do not transplant the F-score rule to tasks without trustworthy reference evidence; first measure whether alternative correct chunk sets are common.
当训练模型必须在固定长上下文中同时改善证据定位和最终作答时，可使用这项工作。以长文档、生成器和可辩护的证据标注方案为起点，复用其记录形式和上下文奖励管理器构造 RL 数据集，再在相同基模型与 rollout 预算下比较仅按答案给分的 RLVR 与混合奖励。没有可信参考证据的任务不应直接移植 F 分数规则；应先测量替代性的正确证据集合是否常见。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Remember five decisions: answer correctness alone leaves grounding uncredited; make chunk choice an emitted field; reward it with precision-recall rather than rewarding every chunk; the released 46K QA records retain context, question, chunk identifiers, and answer; and reproduce the 14B comparison with matched data and rollout budget before claiming an objective-level gain. The first audit is whether the ground-truth chunks are complete enough to distinguish evidence quality from answer luck.
记住五个决策点：只看答案正确性会使定位得不到反馈；应把证据块选择变成显式输出字段；应用精确率和召回率奖励它，而不是奖励所有证据块；公开的 46K 条问答记录保留上下文、问题、块标识符和答案；在声称目标函数带来收益前，应以匹配的数据和 rollout 预算复现实验中的 14B 比较。首要审计是确认真实证据块是否足够完整，能把证据质量与偶然答对区分开。
